item.text:
The report now documents nineteen reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F19: `Learner.syncWithLeader` dereferences a missing proposal for `COMMITANDACTIVATE`**. After a `DIFF` packet, a `COMMITANDACTIVATE` with no preceding proposal causes `packetsNotLogged.peekFirst()` to return null and `pif.hdr` to throw. The reproduction observed:

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot read field "hdr" because "pif" is null
  at org.apache.zookeeper.server.quorum.Learner.syncWithLeader(Learner.java:673)
AssertionError: syncWithLeader dereferenced a missing proposal for COMMITANDACTIVATE
```

Reproduction: [SyncCommitActivateRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/sync_commit_activate/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/SyncCommitActivateRepro.java).

The broader client/server integration pass also passed: `ACLTest`, `CreateTest`, `CreateModeTest`, `CheckTest`, `EventTypeTest`, `DisconnectedWatcherTest`, `ClientRetryTest`, `NullDataTest`, `MultiAsyncTransactionTest`, and `AsyncTest`; the raw log is at `executions/0deb78f954d74b3dae14f3a4096ceed4/stdout.txt`.

The eighteen earlier findings remain documented, including snapshot-fallback state leaks, malformed transaction handling, truncation/epoch recovery defects, oracle election/revalidation issues, follower duplicate/gap handling, epoch initialization failure, duplicate-zxid storage, and the live-path `COMMITANDACTIVATE` queue access. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
